risks.risk: Operational status of engine and alternator
risks.proof: A video of the generator starting, running steadily, and powering a significant electrical load.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's technical specification plate (usually a silver metal plate on the side or near the engine).
A close-up photo of the alternator windings, typically visible through the cooling vents or by removing a small cover.
A clear photo of the hour meter on the control panel.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification plate showing KVA and voltage.
Video of the generator running under load.
Close-up photo of the hour meter on the control panel.
Photo of the alternator windings to confirm copper material.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Hamama EF15000DE diesel generator. The seller's claim of it being a Yamaha is contradicted by the branding in the photo. It is priced as a generic-brand unit in non-working condition until functionality is proven.
